messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started for release v1.42.0 -> canary (us-west-2). SBOM/vuln-scan result: TRANSITIVE_VULN_THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED (1 HIGH, 3 MED). Blocking deploy. https://ci.internal/runs/7823 :warning:
sasha: on it — which package is flagged? any CVE ids?
deploy-bot: Detected: org.lib/foo@2.3.1 -> CVE-2025-1234 (HIGH). transitive via internal-lib/bar@1.8. SBOM: s3://redwood-artifacts/sbom/7823.json
oliver: If CVE-2025-1234 is a deserialization issue, exploitability depends on exposed surface. @security can you triage quickly? we have a 1h change window.
matt: We need a decision: rollback tonight or try a hotfix that would require rebuilding + SBOM regen. What's ETA for pinning?
security: Opening ticket SEC-894 and doing quick triage. Preliminary: CVE-2025-1234 = unsafe deserialization in org.lib/foo <=2.3.1. Exploit requires unauth input to a specific API that we do not expose publicly by default, but our internal routing could surface it in canary. Risk = medium-high. Recommendation: rollback unless a validated mitigation exists.
sasha: We could pin org.lib/foo to 2.3.2 (patched) and rebuild image, but that needs CI -> SBOM -> security re-scan. ETA ~30-45m if nothing breaks.
linh: Change window closes in 45m. If we wait for rebuild we may miss the window and then block other releases. Rollback keeps things safe.
matt: I'm leaning rollback. Can we do a quick compensating control (WAF rule) to block the exploit path for canary? security?
security: WAF rule could reduce exposure but is not a full remediate — it may be acceptable for limited canaries but policy requires security sign-off + mitigation tests. Given time, the safe route is rollback.
oliver: Ok, plan: pause canary, rollback to v1.41.9, create follow-up to re-release after pin+scan+sec-approve. @linh take action? :thumbsup:
linh: Running rollback now:```
/deploy rollback --to v1.41.9 --env canary --reason "transitive CVE-2025-1234"
```
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by linh. Rolling back 3 pods -> desired replica count 3. Pulling image redwood/release:v1.41.9.
deploy-bot: Rollback complete. All canary pods stable on v1.41.9 (3/3). No new alerts.
matt: Thanks. Sasha please update release notes + changelog: mark v1.42.0 deferred due to transitive CVE; link SEC-894. Notify support/sales about the change.
sasha: Will do. I'll also add a short note in #release-updates and schedule the republish once security clears.
security: SEC-894 updated with triage notes + suggested remediation (pin org.lib/foo->2.3.2, regen SBOM, run vuln-scan). Assigning sec-lead for final sign-off.
matt: Good call. We'll aim to re-run release after patch and security sign-off in the next change window. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
